name: Premium Cotton Bedsheet
description: Luxurious 100% cotton bedsheet with 400 thread count. Soft, breathable, and durable. Available in multiple colors.
detailedDescription: Experience ultimate comfort with our Premium Cotton Bedsheet. Made from 100% long-staple cotton, this bedsheet offers exceptional softness and durability. The 400 thread count ensures a luxurious feel while maintaining breathability for a comfortable night's sleep. Perfect for all seasons, these bedsheets get softer with every wash.
careInstructions: Machine wash in cold water with similar colors
Use mild detergent, avoid bleach
Tumble dry on low or line dry
Iron on medium heat if needed
Do not dry clean

name: Floral Print Bedsheet Set
description: Beautiful floral print bedsheet set with 2 pillow covers. Premium microfiber fabric with vibrant colors.
detailedDescription: Transform your bedroom into a floral paradise with this stunning bedsheet set. Crafted from premium microfiber fabric, it features vibrant, fade-resistant colors that stay beautiful wash after wash. The set includes 2 matching pillow covers for a complete coordinated look. Wrinkle-resistant and easy to maintain.
careInstructions: Machine wash in cold water
Wash dark colors separately for first wash
Do not bleach
Tumble dry low
Iron on low temperature if needed

name: Luxury Silk Bedsheet
description: Ultra-premium silk bedsheet for the ultimate sleep experience. Hypoallergenic and temperature regulating.
detailedDescription: Indulge in luxury with our 100% Mulberry Silk Bedsheet. This premium silk naturally regulates temperature, keeping you cool in summer and warm in winter. The smooth, hypoallergenic surface is gentle on skin and hair, reducing friction and preventing wrinkles. Perfect for those with sensitive skin or allergies. Experience the difference that true luxury makes in your sleep quality.
careInstructions: Hand wash in cold water with silk-safe detergent
Or dry clean for best results
Do not bleach or use harsh chemicals
Air dry flat, away from direct sunlight
Iron on silk setting if needed (use cloth barrier)

name: Memory Foam Pillow
description: Ergonomic memory foam pillow for neck and spine support. Perfect for side and back sleepers.
detailedDescription: Wake up refreshed with our Ergonomic Memory Foam Pillow. Designed by sleep experts, this pillow provides optimal cervical support to align your spine and reduce neck pain. The premium memory foam contours to your unique head and neck shape, providing personalized comfort throughout the night. The breathable cover keeps you cool and comfortable all night long.
careInstructions: Remove and wash pillow cover regularly
Machine wash cover in cold water
Do not wash memory foam core
Spot clean foam with damp cloth if needed
Air out pillow monthly for freshness

name: Winter Comforter
description: Ultra-warm winter comforter with microfiber filling. Lightweight yet incredibly cozy for cold nights.
detailedDescription: Stay warm and cozy all winter long with our Premium Winter Comforter. Filled with high-quality microfiber that mimics down's warmth without the allergens. The unique quilting pattern keeps the filling evenly distributed, preventing cold spots. Lightweight design doesn't weigh you down while providing exceptional warmth. Perfect for those chilly winter nights.
careInstructions: Machine wash on gentle cycle with cold water
Use large capacity washer for best results
Tumble dry on low heat with dryer balls
Fluff regularly to maintain loft
Professional cleaning recommended annually
